requirement_summary: 규제산업 Enterprise Edition SoD: 동일 사용자가 같은 ImprovementRequest의 개발(DEVELOP)/검증(VERIFY)/최종인수(ACCEPT)를 모두 수행할 수 없다 (ENFORCED policy). 일반 Plan은 권고만 한다 (ADVISORY policy).
subject: src/main/java/kr/co/oruda/onsure/platform/SeparationOfDutiesLedger.java
coverage_notes: ENFORCED policy rejects the same actor performing a conflicting stage before any record is written (real SecurityException, not a soft warning). ADVISORY policy records the conflict rather than silently accepting it as an unrelated stage. Distinct actors across DEVELOP/VERIFY/ACCEPT are never flagged as a false conflict. Tamper-evidence added under Autonomous Development Mode (2026-08-15) hash-chain hardening.
